pages.text: The finale awards Ranker’s Sword, also called Tears for Fears, and four Potions of Radiation. Radiation is harmful; handle those bottles accordingly.$(br2)Complete the final sword task after your Inferno victory to mark your completion of Outlandish Revelations.

You started with a small workshop. You learned to find resources, turn them into useful processes, explore hostile worlds and build equipment worthy of the final encounter. Take a look around your base—you built the supply lines behind that victory.
Thank you for playing. Keep building, help your teammates reach their own milestones, and share useful issue reports when something needs attention.
